title: Personal Checking: Direct Deposit and Debit Card Purchase Waivers Read From the Ledger
content:
## Rule

When a Personal Checking maintenance fee dated the cycle closing date is reviewed on that same business day, two waivers that the account's own ledger settles are judged as well, each only where the tier offers it:

- **Direct deposit waiver** — met when the ACH direct deposits posted in the cycle add up to at least the tier's direct deposit level.
- **Debit card purchase waiver** — met when the debit card purchases posted in the cycle, domestic point-of-sale and international together, number at least the tier's purchase count.

The stretch of time these waivers look at opens on the day following the prior cycle close and runs up to today, the current business day, inclusive. A waiver the tier lists as not offered plays no part.

## Reading the ledger

| Entry type in the cycle | Counts toward |
|---|---|
| ACH direct deposit credit | direct deposit total |
| other ACH credit, mobile deposit, Zelle receipt, transfer in | neither waiver |
| debit card purchase at a point of sale, domestic | purchase count |
| debit card purchase, international | purchase count |
| ATM withdrawal, Zelle payment, ACH debit, check | neither waiver |

## Hypothetical cases (illustrative tier levels: direct deposits 700.00 USD, purchases 12)

- Direct deposits of 350.00 and 350.00 USD posted in the cycle: total 700.00 USD, level reached, waiver met.
- Eleven domestic and one international debit card purchase: twelve purchases, waiver met.
- On a tier where both waivers are marked not offered, neither is judged, however large the deposits or purchases.
